notes.title: The Future of Bakken - Ski Jumping and Kassei - Road Cycling
notes.content:
After the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3460060/Bakken__Ski_Jumping_2025/]Bakken - Ski Jumping 2025[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3653030/Kassei__Road_Cycling_2025/]Kassei - Road Cycling 2025[/url] SE {} KS has decided to deactivate the demos of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197930/Bakken__Ski_Jumping/]Bakken - Ski Jumping (2024)[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331040/Kassei__Road_Cycling/]Kassei - Road Cycling (2024)[/url] ...

Thanks for playing!
